contract_delta.repair: The package explicitly declares the complete polygamma pole exclusion instead of deriving it from z != 0; the source dossier is unchanged.

predicates.statement: The recurrence order is the fixed positive integer n=2.
z is not 0,-1,-2,..., the pole set of polygamma(2,z).
z+1 is outside the polygamma pole set whenever P002 holds.

verifier_scope_note: The exact discrete pole exclusion is carried by this contract; symbols.json selects complex-probe mode but cannot encode excluded integer sets.
